verdict.rationale: OpenCode's first-party GitHub integration documents that, when asked to fix an issue or implement a feature, it works in a new branch and submits a PR with all the changes, triggered by /opencode or /oc comments inside GitHub Actions. That covers the core of the story: branch creation and PR opening, with commits implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of staging and commit-message generation, evidence of local terminal-driven git workflows outside GitHub Actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
